statements.impact_statement: CVE-2026-33997 is a privilege-validation bypass in the Moby daemon's plugin installation. connaisseur (./cmd/connaisseur) imports only github.com/docker/docker/registry and api/types/registry, in internal/validator/notaryv1/notaryserver/client.go:20-21 and simple_cred_store.go:7, to authenticate against Notary v1 registries. Checked with `go list -deps ./cmd/connaisseur` at v3.11.1, v3.12.0 and v3.13.0: no daemon, plugin manager or API server package is in the build. The build fails if one is ever linked. The fix (29.3.1) exists only under the github.com/moby/moby module path, so the +incompatible module cannot be floated to it.
